nodes.name: Biohazard
nodes.description: Attacker suffers Poison damage when striking a defender with a Bleed debuff active. Defender suffers Bleed damage when striking an attacker with a Poison debuff active.

counters.tips: Use champions immune to both Bleed and Poison, or avoid triggering debuffs.

nodes.name: Buffet
nodes.description: When a Buff expires on the defender, they degenerate the attacker for 1% of their max health per stack.

counters.tips: Use champions that don't rely on buffs, or convert enemy buffs into debuffs.

nodes.name: Power Shield
nodes.description: While the defender has any Power, they take 80% reduced damage. Remove their Power to deal normal damage.

counters.tips: Bring strong power control champions. Power Burn is the most effective counter.

nodes.name: Stun Immunity
nodes.description: The defender cannot be stunned. Any attempt to stun them triggers a burst of degeneration.

counters.tips: Avoid relying on stun-heavy rotations. Use damage-over-time champions.

nodes.name: Masochism
nodes.description: When a non-damaging debuff is placed on the defender, they shrug it off and regenerate a small amount of health.

counters.tips: Use damaging debuffs (Bleed, Poison, Shock, Incinerate) rather than non-damaging ones (Armor Break, Stun, Weakness).

nodes.name: Aspect of War
nodes.description: Both players start the fight with a timer. If the fight goes past the timer, you are instantly defeated. Intercepting the opponent pauses the timer.

counters.tips: Master intercepting. Aggressive playstyles counter this node best.

nodes.name: Aspect of Nightmare
nodes.description: While defender is not stunned, striking them with a light or medium attack has a chance to reverse controls for 3 seconds.

counters.tips: Keep the defender stunned. Heavy attacks and specials bypass the reversal chance.

nodes.name: Poison
nodes.description: All attacks have a chance to inflict Poison debuffs that deal X damage per second.

counters.tips: Poison immune champions are the hard counter.

nodes.name: Bleed
nodes.description: All attacks have a chance to inflict Bleed debuffs that deal X damage per second.

counters.tips: Bleed immune champions trivialize this node.

nodes.name: Incinerate
nodes.description: All attacks have a chance to inflict Incinerate debuffs that deal X damage per second.

counters.tips: Incinerate immune champions counter this node.

nodes.name: Cold Snap
nodes.description: Inflicts Cold Snap debuffs. Champions not immune to Cold take damage over time and have reduced Ability Accuracy.

counters.tips: Cold immunity is a hard counter. Iceman and Colossus both have it.

nodes.name: Shock
nodes.description: All attacks have a chance to inflict Shock debuffs.

counters.tips: Shock immune champions counter this node.

nodes.name: Void
nodes.description: The defender has 500% increased health. They cannot have their power reduced below one bar.

counters.tips: Champions with lots of ramp-up damage do well. Avoid power control as it won't work.

nodes.name: Node 30
nodes.description: This node contains a very difficult defender. Defeating them grants you a permanent boost for the rest of the quest.

counters.tips: Save your best champion for this fight. Plan your path around it.

nodes.name: Spite
nodes.description: When the defender has a debuff removed or expires, they gain a stack of Spite, increasing their attack rating.

counters.tips: Avoid placing many short-duration debuffs. Convert buffs rather than placing debuffs.

nodes.name: Power Reserve 1
nodes.description: The defender starts the fight with 1 bar of power.

counters.tips: Drain or burn their starting power immediately.

nodes.name: Power Reserve 2
nodes.description: The defender starts the fight with 2 bars of power.

counters.tips: Important to drain or avoid their specials. Can one-shot you.

nodes.name: Power Reserve 3
nodes.description: The defender starts the fight with 3 bars of power.

counters.tips: The defender will almost certainly use SP3 immediately. Dexterity timing is critical.

nodes.name: Regeneration
nodes.description: The defender regenerates X% health every 5 seconds.

counters.tips: Heal reversal or heal block abilities are essential.

nodes.name: Armor Up
nodes.description: The defender periodically gains Armor Up buffs, reducing physical damage taken.

counters.tips: Armor break or energy damage cuts through this node.

nodes.name: Evade
nodes.description: The defender has a chance to evade attacks. Evade chance increases with defender's health loss.

counters.tips: True Strike completely counters evade. Heimdall and Corvus are excellent choices.

nodes.name: Auto-Block
nodes.description: The defender has a chance to automatically block incoming attacks.

counters.tips: True Strike and Lock-On counter auto-block.

nodes.name: Unblockable Specials
nodes.description: The defender's special attacks are unblockable.

counters.tips: Must be evaded or avoided. Dexterity and phasing are your best friends.

nodes.name: Degeneration
nodes.description: Both players degenerate X% health per second. Fighting aggressively reduces degeneration rate.

counters.tips: Regen-heavy champions or Willpower mastery can offset the degeneration.

nodes.name: ROFF (Reverse of Fate)
nodes.description: All healing effects become degeneration. All degeneration effects become healing. Buffs and debuffs swap polarity.

counters.tips: Avoid using regen or degen effects. Pure damage champions work best.

nodes.name: Limbo
nodes.description: Every 15 hits in the defender's combo, they gain a Limbo charge. When the Limbo expires, the attacker takes burst damage.

counters.tips: Nullify or Fate Seal the Limbo charges before they expire.

nodes.name: Flux
nodes.description: The defender applies a passive Flux debuff. Flux Armor reduces physical damage while Flux Shield reduces energy damage. Switches every 10 seconds.

counters.tips: Use champions that deal both physical and energy damage, or wait for the flux to switch.

nodes.name: Caltrops
nodes.description: Dashing back causes the attacker to suffer a Bleed debuff. Dashing forward and striking the defender applies a passive Armor Break.

counters.tips: Minimize dashing back. Aggressive play and bleeds-immune champs help.

nodes.name: Toxic Pustules
nodes.description: When a buff expires on either player, they suffer a Poison debuff. When a debuff expires on either player, they suffer a Bleed debuff.

counters.tips: Dual immunity champions are best here. Avoid placing short duration buffs/debuffs.

nodes.name: Bubble Shield
nodes.description: The defender periodically activates a Bubble Shield that absorbs all damage for 3 seconds. Only heavy attacks can break the shield.

counters.tips: Use heavy attacks to break the bubble. Champions with heavy attack utility shine.

nodes.name: Life Transfer
nodes.description: Every time the defender loses 5% health, the attacker loses 1% health. Regeneration effects are shared.

counters.tips: Regen helps offset the life transfer damage. Burst damage minimizes exposure.

nodes.name: Stun Reflect
nodes.description: Any attempt to stun the defender reflects the stun back onto the attacker.

counters.tips: Avoid using stun-based rotations. Focus on DOT or direct damage champions.

nodes.name: Falling Damage
nodes.description: When the defender is knocked down (e.g., from a heavy attack or SP3), their fall forces the attacker to take X% damage.

counters.tips: Avoid knocking the defender down. Use DOT champs that don't require knockdowns.

nodes.name: Power Lock
nodes.description: Both players cannot gain power for the first 10 seconds of the fight.

counters.tips: Focus on basic attack damage for the first 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Kick
nodes.description: When the attacker triggers a special attack, the defender kicks them for X% damage.

counters.tips: Use basic attacks and heavy attacks. Avoid specials or use them sparingly.

nodes.name: Oblivion (OS)
nodes.description: Every 10 seconds, all buffs and debuffs on both players are removed and converted into burst damage to the player they were affecting.

counters.tips: Use champions that don't rely on stacking many buffs or debuffs.
